correctness.rationale: Read the Haar-probability normalization and SO(3) character orthogonality: the exact Gram is (2ell+1)/12 times character chi_ell(Ru^-1 Rv). Quaternion multiplication classifies relative angles 0,72,120,144 degrees from icosahedral inner products. The icosahedron association matrices satisfy B=PA, P^2=I, A^2=5I+2A+2B; their four common sectors have dimensions 1,5,3,3 and yield exactly the four branches. The stated low-degree eigenvalues give ranks 1,9,11, and uniform character bounds plus explicit ell3..6 values imply positivity for all ell>=3. Independently constructed exact-coordinate adjacency matrices and numerically diagonalized Gram for ell0..20, reproducing all branches and ranks. The 21-degree check corroborates, while the uniform analytic bounds prove all integer degrees. This is evaluation surjectivity at ell>=3, not injectivity of an ell-harmonic space when its dimension exceeds 12.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks corroborate, but where the statement is infinite only the reconstructed analytic argument justifies the universal quantifier.
